source_path.description: Source directory or file path for Mbox data. Relative to home unless absolute. Set source_file or source_dir alongside this to define the path.

source_file.description: If true, source_path points to a single mbox file. If false, it points to a directory.

source_dir.description: Specific source directory name relative to home if source_path is used as a base. Often used with source_file=false.

dest_dir.description: Destination directory for Maildir format. Relative to home unless absolute.

use_content_length.description: Use Content-Length: headers to find message boundaries. Use with caution.

is_mailbox_for_user.description: Use -m flag. Source is /var/spool/mail/username. Destination is destdir.

strip_extension.description: Extension to strip from original mbox filename (without leading dot).

recursive.description: Run recursively into directories (-R flag). Incompatible with -f.

folder_name.description: Specific subdirectory name in sourcedir to convert (-f flag). Incompatible with -R.
